title: WAGR-98 still leans to 'edit terms in place' and asks questions the meetings already answered

what_differs: WAGR-98 (Requirements, Must Have) recommends editing terms in place with Field History. Meetings decided a dated Commercial Terms custom object (2026-09-29 internal, 2026-09-30 client sync) and that a deal returning with new terms stays the same deal (2026-09-11).
suggested_action: Record the decision on WAGR-98 (dated child object; reactivation keeps the same deal) and close it, as WAGR-462 already plans, so nobody builds Option 1.
